source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07PE, proof of the final statement

proof.text: Use the localization clause of Derivation.exists_completion_and_unique_localization for the powers of g to obtain Dw on R_g with Dw(r/1)=D(r)/1.

The bijective canonical map gives a ring isomorphism e : R_g ≃ R'_g. Define δ=e ∘ Dw ∘ e⁻¹ as a composition of additive homomorphisms. Its integer-linearity follows from additivity, it sends one to zero, and the Leibniz identity follows by applying e to the identity for Dw.
IsLocalization.map_eq gives e(r/1)=ι'(r). Substitute into the formula for δ, cancel e⁻¹ ∘ e, and use the extension identity for Dw to obtain δ(ι'(r))=ι'(D(r)).

title: Transport of a derivation across an away-localization isomorphism
statement: Let R and R' be commutative rings with an injective algebra map R → R', let g ∈ R, and assume the induced canonical map R_g → R'_g is bijective. For every absolute derivation D : R → R, there exists an absolute derivation δ : R'_g → R'_g with δ(ι'(r)) = ι'(D(r)) for every r ∈ R. No finite type or regularity assumption is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_derivation_away_transport
    (R : Type u) (R' : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [Algebra R R']
    (_hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R R')) (g : R)
    (hiso : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away g)
        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' g)) (algebraMap R R') g))
    (D : Derivation ℤ R R) :
    ∃ δ : Derivation ℤ (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' g))
        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' g)),
      ∀ r : R, δ (algebraMap R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' g))
        (algebraMap R R' r)) =
        algebraMap R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' g))
          (algebraMap R R' (D r))
